vo.text: Every group project has one. The chat where links go to get lost.
Now there's a better place for them.
With Shared Folders in Ardia, a folder in your sidebar can belong to everyone you work with.
Share it with anyone who has an Apple ID. It lives in iCloud Drive, so there's no new account to make.
When someone adds a link, it shows up for everyone, right away.
Rename it, reorder it, tuck it into a subfolder. Everyone sees the same folder.
